title: Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent: Self-Structuring Learning through Question Answering
abstract: arXiv:2611.34841v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider the problem of constructing knowledge bases for applications based on large language models, in which the structure of a knowledge base determines how an application can retrieve and connect the information needed to answer a question. We study Self-Structuring Learning, a setting in which questions and expected answers guide the construction of a persistent knowledge base whose editable structure can be a graph schema or the organization of linked knowledge documents. We propose Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent, which diagnoses discrepancies between expected answers and responses obtained through the current knowledge base. At each round, the method proposes a structural edit, rebuilds the knowledge base, and adopts the edit when the learning loss decreases. The retained structure is evaluated on other questions about the same sources. By randomizing over candidate edits, we express the loss change of an edit as a derivative

translated_title: 知识库梯度下降：通过问答实现的自结构化学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究为基于大语言模型的应用构建知识库的问题，其中知识库的结构决定了应用如何检索和连接回答问题所需的信息。我们研究自结构化学习这一设定，即由问题和预期答案来指导构建一个持久的知识库，其可编辑的结构可以是图模式或链接知识文档的组织方式。我们提出知识库梯度下降方法，该方法诊断预期答案与通过当前知识库获得的响应之间的差异。在每一轮中，该方法提出一个结构性编辑，重建知识库，并在学习损失下降时采纳该编辑。所保留的结构会在关于相同资料来源的其他问题上进行评估。通过对候选编辑进行随机化，我们将某次编辑带来的损失变化表示为导数……（摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“知识库梯度下降”方法，通过诊断问答响应与预期答案之间的差异，并以类似梯度下降的方式迭代地对知识库结构提出编辑、验证并保留能降低损失的编辑，从而让大语言模型应用能够以问题和答案为监督信号自动学习构建最优的知识库结构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Knowledge-Base Gradient Descent, which iteratively optimizes the structure of a persistent knowledge base—like gradient descent—by diagnosing discrepancies between expected answers and model responses, proposing structural edits, and retaining those that reduce the learning loss.
